profile.name: Ashik Rai
profile.tagline: Backend-first Engineer (C++, Go, gRPC) who also ships full-stack | Observability & Agentic AI
profile.bioShort: Hi there, I'm Ashik — a Software Engineer based in India, currently working at IBM.
profile.bioLong: Backend-focused Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and building high-performance, reliable systems in C++, Go, and JavaScript/TypeScript, complemented by strong front-end delivery using React.js. Proven track record building observability and telemetry pipelines (eBPF, Prometheus, Grafana), production-grade APIs (gRPC, Protocol Buffers, REST), and payment platforms for global banking and airline clients. Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI workflows with n8n and Flowise — including Agentic RAG pipelines, MCP server/client integrations, vector-embedding search with Supabase, and voice-enabled conversational agents — and applying AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and improve code quality. Adept at cross-functional collaboration, rapid learning of new technology stacks, and translating complex requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.

experience.description: Built a lightweight eBPF-based network flow collection service for IBM Cloud, replacing a legacy tool while cutting memory footprint and operational overhead. Own the Prometheus/Grafana observability stack, and built a React.js monitoring app that reduced status-checking effort by over 90%.
Led security scanning across multiple repositories (Fortify, BlackDuck, Secrets, Prisma), triaging findings and delivering comprehensive security reports for multiple airline clients.

Built payment applications in C++ and Android for major banking clients (HDFC, SBI, FirstData, Hitachi, KBANK, BBL). Automated reporting (95% effort reduction) and integrated AWS MQTT/Polly into payment workflows.
Developed and enhanced responsive web applications using React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and GraphQL, with reusable components in Material UI and Redux state management.
